Blender 5.2.3 LTS
Usage: blender [args ...] [file] [args ...]

Render Options:
-b or --background
	Run in background (often used for UI-less rendering).

	The audio device is disabled in background-mode by default
	and can be re-enabled by passing in '-setaudio Default' afterwards.
-a or --render-anim
	Render frames from start to end (inclusive).
-f or --render-frame <frame>
	Render frame <frame> and save it.

Cycles Render Options:
	Cycles add-on options must be specified following a double dash.
--cycles-device <device>
	Set the device used for rendering.
--cycles-print-stats
	Log statistics about render memory and time usage.

Animation Playback Options:
-a <options> <file(s)>
	Run as an animation player (ignored if '-b' is set).
	Playback Arguments:
	-f <fps> <fps_base>
		Specify FPS to start with.
	-p <sx> <sy>
		Open with lower left corner at <sx>, <sy>.

Python Options:
--python-expr <expression>
	Run the given expression as a Python script.
--python-exit-code <code>
	Set the exit-code if a Python exception is raised
	(only for scripts executed from the command line), zero disables.

Logging Options:
--log <match>
	Enable logging categories.
	--log "*": log everything
	--log "event": logs every category starting with 'event'.

Misc Options:
-noaudio
	Force sound system to None.
/?
	Print this help text and exit (Windows only).
--
	End option processing, following arguments passed unchanged.
--last <arg>
	This option must be last argument.

Argument Order:
	Arguments are executed in the order they are given. eg:
	# blender --background test.blend --render-frame 1

Environment Variables:
  $BLENDER_USER_CONFIG Directory for user configuration files.
